415a1063368d.en: Jobs in the Four Kingdoms are ranked in tiers, from Tier VI (kings, queens and courtroom scientists, the richest people in the kingdoms) down through artisans, merchants, guards, adventurers, maids and farmers. Each entry lists how the job came to be, what it requires, and which schooling it takes.
